title: Kouryuu Sangoku Engi
overview: Kouryuu Sangoku Engi is a historical simulation game set in the Three Kingdoms era of Chinese history, and a sequel to Shōryū Sangokushi. It plays much like its predecessor, allowing the the player to select a warlord and attempt to unify China under their rule through deft political and war maneuvering. New in this release are refined visuals and mechanics, a new "high risk" difficulty option, and an additional new scenario. There is also a new mode where the goal is not to defeat all challengers but rather to lead their chosen warlord to the same fate they met in real life history.
